title: Legends in Concert Myrtle Beach Admission
includes: Admission to Legends In Concert Show
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please note: acts are subject to change without notice
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Legends in Concerts , The World's Greatest Live Tribute Show, All Live, All the Time. Spring brings an exciting lineup with The Blues, Brothers, Bruno Mars, Carrie Underwood(Steve Perry will replace Carrie on April 13) and Elvis Presley with singer/dancers and a live band. You will not find a more professional collection of entertainers that up close and personal in our comfortable, interactive theater. A "can't miss" show in Myrtle Beach!
